objs.name: document
objs.description: Managed artifact created, edited, released, distributed, archived, revised, invalidated, reactivated, translated, displayed, and evaluated in DHC VISION.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Type selected when creating a new document, such as policy, guideline, procedural instruction, or work instruction.

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Level used to differentiate and structure documents.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Abbreviation assigned to a document and adaptable to requirements.

attributes.name: consecutive_number
attributes.description: Number assigned to a document and adaptable to requirements.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Status metadata of the document, including editing, released, invalidated, or out of force states described in the process.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Scope metadata that can be printed in the document using TAG technology.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which document validity starts.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date calculated from Valid From and Period Of Extended Validity.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Period after which a validity check is necessary for the document type.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Duration for which an invalidated document is archived before physical deletion.

attributes.name: distribution_by_info
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect e-mail notification when the next version is released.

attributes.name: distribution_for_acknowledgement
attributes.description: Attribute whose changes affect distribution of acknowledgement workflow tasks when the next version is released.

attributes.name: original_language_version
attributes.description: Language version whose released state is required before translation.

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type used for company-wide regulations and processes at a strategic level.

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type used to describe locally defined regulations or regulations relating to a business process.

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequence, details, and responsible persons within a framework.

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type documenting detailed work steps that go beyond the scope of procedural instructions.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Template defined for a document type and selected when creating new document objects.

objs.name: object_cover
objs.description: Pure object cover to which external files or documents can be uploaded or from which new documents can be generated.

objs.name: external_file
objs.description: File uploaded to an object cover.

objs.name: office_document
objs.description: Document generated based on standard MS Office formats such as Excel, Word, or PowerPoint.

objs.name: pdf
objs.description: Converted format automatically created after saving the document and displayed on the web.

objs.name: metadata
objs.description: Standardized and customer-specific metadata maintained for a document in categories.

objs.name: category
objs.description: Grouping of document attributes and metadata according to purpose.

objs.name: reference
objs.description: Attribute maintained via document properties to link documents to master data or other documents.

objs.name: it_application
objs.description: Master data example that can be linked with documents.

objs.name: company
objs.description: Relevant company maintained via document properties to link documents.

objs.name: area_of_validity
objs.description: Area of validity maintained via document properties to link documents.

objs.name: process
objs.description: Process object with which documents can be automatically linked or for which documents can be filed.

objs.name: organizational_unit
objs.description: Organizational unit with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: risk
objs.description: Risk object with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: master_data
objs.description: Master data with which documents can be automatically linked.

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual system participant who creates, edits, reviews, releases, reads, translates, acknowledges, or otherwise processes objects.

attributes.name: system_role
attributes.description: Role implemented in DHC VISION to provide users with functions according to their area of application.

attributes.name: license_role
attributes.description: License role shown in brackets for system roles.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Group of users used for authorization, reader assignment, distribution, and role-specific availability.

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User assigned as reader who can view approved objects and dependent objects.

objs.name: author
objs.description: User registered as author of a document and signer of the creator workflow step.

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: User with personal change rights on a document and its details, without relevance within the release workflow.

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User who checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User responsible for the document and its content who decides whether it is distributed to readers.

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User who can translate released content of the DHC VISION system into another language.

objs.name: creator
objs.description: User who creates a document, change proposal, or request and may be the initiator of a workflow step.

objs.name: applicant
objs.description: Initiator of a request for Override in the described process.

objs.name: archive_group
objs.description: Specific user group retaining read access to archived documents when other rights are revoked.

objs.name: business_admin_group
objs.description: Group permitted to create requests for reactivation.

objs.name: authorization
objs.description: Read or change right assigned to users, user groups, or persons for documents and dependent details.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attached to a main document, automatically released with the main document, subject to versioning, and archived with release of the next main document version.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary object added to a document, released and published directly via switches in properties, and not subject to the main document release cycle.

objs.name: equippment
objs.description: Object described as additional relevant Equippment or as document attachment in the source, added to or archived with documents.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposal created for a document without affecting content or version history, displayed in the document and managed in the Change proposals folder.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: System-created request linked to a document 30 days before validity expires and processed with workflow support.

objs.name: request_for_aks
objs.description: Request created to invalidate or override a selected document and processed by workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: Request created in a provided folder to reactivate an invalidated document.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: System-supported processing flow for release, validity extension, Override, reactivation, acknowledgement, and translation checks/releases.

objs.name: workflow_task
objs.description: Task assigned to workflow participants and communicated by e-mail notification.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Signature used by workflow participants to complete tasks and documented for each released version.

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Documented participant signature that can be printed as document content.

objs.name: e_mail_notification
objs.description: Notification sent to involved users about workflow tasks, released versions, change proposals, acknowledgement requests, and validity or Override information.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons maintained for a document, granting read authorization and driving e-mail or acknowledgement distribution and dashboard assignment.

objs.name: person
objs.description: Individual assigned in authorization, participant, or distribution attributes.

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation of acknowledgement requested from persons or users of assigned user groups and documented without signature.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: Role-specific display listing documents relevant to users based on distribution and other role information.

objs.name: report
objs.description: Evaluation report or search available for documents and acknowledgements using selection parameters and criteria.

objs.name: selection_parameter
objs.description: Parameter used in reports to influence evaluation results.

objs.name: selection_criteria
objs.description: Criteria used in reports to filter result lists.

objs.name: client
objs.description: Client in a multi-client system in which document visibility can be specified.

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated version of a released document that must be checked and released before visibility in the corresponding login language.

objs.name: local_document
objs.description: New document created in a client to describe a local addition or extension and reference the original document.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Create a new document in DHC VISION by attachment of a new information object and selection of a document type.

evts.name: select_document_template
evts.description: Select one or more defined templates when creating a new document object.

evts.name: create_object_cover
evts.description: Create a pure object cover for later upload or generation of documents.

evts.name: upload_external_file
evts.description: Upload external files or documents to an object cover.

evts.name: generate_office_document
evts.description: Generate new documents based on standard MS Office formats.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain document properties, including standardized and customer-specific metadata.

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Maintain metadata grouped by purpose in categories.

evts.name: maintain_document_control
evts.description: Define document control after document creation and content and attribute maintenance.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Assign group-related and person-related authorizations in document properties.

evts.name: assign_reader
evts.description: Assign reader authorizations via user group assignment in the Reader attribute.

evts.name: assign_author
evts.description: Assign the author of a document in the Author field or selection list.

evts.name: assign_co_author
evts.description: Assign additional personal change rights through the Co-authors attribute.

evts.name: assign_reviewer
evts.description: Assign reviewers maintained in document attributes for the review step.

evts.name: assign_releaser
evts.description: Assign releasers maintained in document attributes for the release step.

evts.name: assign_translator
evts.description: Assign participants for checking and releasing translation in document properties.

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Edit document content using the implemented editing client and local Office component.

evts.name: print_metadata
evts.description: Automatically print document metadata in the document using integrated TAG technology.

evts.name: save_document
evts.description: Save the document after content editing.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically and system-supported convert a saved document to PDF.

evts.name: display_pdf
evts.description: Display the current PDF version on the web.

evts.name: change_document_content
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document content.

evts.name: change_document_properties
evts.description: Make subsequent changes to document properties.

evts.name: create_editing_version
evts.description: Automatically create a new editing version when a released document is revised or affected by attachment changes.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: Add an object of type Additional info to a document.

evts.name: release_additional_info
evts.description: Release additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: publish_additional_info
evts.description: Publish additional information directly via switches in properties.

evts.name: modify_additional_info
evts.description: Modify additional information without affecting the main document.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: Delete additional information directly due to lack of criticality.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: Add an Attachment to a document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: Modify an Attachment, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark an Attachment for archiving and archive it with the release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: delete_edited_version
evts.description: Delete existing edited versions after declaration of Out of force.

evts.name: start_release_process
evts.description: Initiate the workflow-supported 3-step release process consisting of Creator, Review, and Release.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: Registered author signs the Creator workflow step.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: Reviewer checks document content according to technical and formal aspects.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: Releaser completes release so the document is finally released.

evts.name: reject_review_or_release
evts.description: Reject during review or release, canceling workflow for subsequent participants after first rejection.

evts.name: send_e_mail_notification
evts.description: System informs involved users of workflow status, tasks, released versions, change proposals, acknowledgement requests, validity extension, or override information by e-mail.

evts.name: complete_workflow_task
evts.description: Workflow participant completes a task with an electronic signature or, for acknowledgement, without signature.

evts.name: document_signature
evts.description: Document individual participant signatures in the system for each released version.

evts.name: print_signature
evts.description: Print documented signatures as document content.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Automatically publish the document after release, making it visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Revise a valid and released document, automatically creating a new editing version.

evts.name: retain_previous_version_data
evts.description: Retain data from the previous version in a newly created editing version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Create a Change proposal for a document without affecting its content or version history.

evts.name: display_change_proposal
evts.description: Display a Change proposal in the document.

evts.name: print_change_proposal
evts.description: Print Change proposals in a document for information purposes if the document is already being revised.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: Schedule a Change proposal for implementation, creating a new document version.

evts.name: edit_change_proposal
evts.description: Author documents editing of assigned Change proposals directly in the Change proposal.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: Complete a Change proposal so it is no longer displayed in the document.

evts.name: manage_change_proposal
evts.description: Manage Change proposals in the Cockpit for a document in the Change proposals folder.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: System creates a request for validity extension 30 days before validity expires.

evts.name: process_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Process the request for validity extension with workflow support.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: Declare additional validity so the document remains valid in its current version and Valid until is updated.

evts.name: delete_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: Delete the request for validity extension after additional validity or release of a revised version.

evts.name: terminate_validity_extension_process
evts.description: Automatically terminate the validity extension process with release of a revised version or after suspension based on the validity extension check.

evts.name: create_request_for_aks
evts.description: Create a request for AKS for a selected document to invalidate or override it.

evts.name: start_aks_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for processing a request for AKS after attachment of the request.

evts.name: check_request_for_aks
evts.description: Creator of the request checks the request and the document in the first AKS step.

evts.name: review_aks
evts.description: Reviewers carry out review of the AKS.

evts.name: approve_aks
evts.description: Releasers carry out approval of the AKS.

evts.name: declare_out_of_force
evts.description: Declare the document Out of force, set the last valid approved version to Out of force, and archive it.

evts.name: revoke_rights
evts.description: Revoke all rights except for the archive group during archiving or invalidation.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: Physically delete documents after the archive period has expired.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: Create a request for reactivation in the provided folder and select the document for reactivation.

evts.name: start_reactivation_workflow
evts.description: Automatically start workflow for reactivation request.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: Creator of the request confirms reactivation in the workflow step.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Re-validate invalidated documents by creating a new version and restoring original status except version number and status.

evts.name: reactivate_equippment
evts.description: Reactivate Equippments archived with the document.

evts.name: set_authorization
evts.description: Set authorizations according to maintained reader, author, co-author, reviewer, and releaser attributes during reactivation.

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Maintain user groups and persons assigned to Distribution in the document cockpit.

evts.name: grant_read_authorization
evts.description: Automatically grant read authorization to all user groups and persons assigned to the Distribution.

evts.name: distribute_by_e_mail
evts.description: Inform directly assigned users and users of assigned user groups by e-mail when a new document version is released.

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically request recipients by e-mail to actively confirm acknowledgement upon release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Recipient confirms acknowledgement of the relevant document through workflow support without signature.

evts.name: monitor_acknowledgement
evts.description: Author team receives overview of unconfirmed acknowledgements and notification when all acknowledgements are confirmed.

evts.name: fill_dashboard
evts.description: Fill user and role-specific dashboards based on distribution groups assigned per document.

evts.name: display_document_list
evts.description: List all documents relevant to a user in the Document list dashboard.

evts.name: display_document_details
evts.description: Display details such as Attachments, additional information, referenced documents, and language versions for a selected document.

evts.name: navigate_additional_info
evts.description: Navigate deeper via additional information from the dashboard.

evts.name: evaluate_report
evts.description: Evaluate documents, instructions, workflow status, or acknowledgements based on selected parameters and criteria.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Translator translates released document content into another language.

evts.name: check_translation
evts.description: Translated version is checked with workflow support.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Translated version is released with workflow support.

evts.name: display_language_version
evts.description: Display released translated document to authorized readers in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: specify_client_visibility
evts.description: Specify in which clients a corresponding document is visible or not.

evts.name: create_local_document
evts.description: Create a new document in a client to describe a local addition or extension.

evts.name: reference_original_document
evts.description: Create a reference from a local document to the original document.
